rationale: fastdiff_wdm_wavelet_unconstrained-claude-agentic: val_n=200, seed=42, fd_recon_ckpt=/cluster/maier/Agent4CT/checkpoints/fast_diffusion_wavelet_breast.pt, fd_recon_steps=8, fd_recon_init=fbp, fd_recon_init_t=0.5, fd_recon_eta=2.0, fd_recon_dc=0, fd_recon_dc_n_cg=5, fd_recon_dc_relax=0.5, dataset_kind=breast_ct, rationale=iter-5 ETA (DPS soft-DC strength) lever, breast-native wdm-wavelet UNCONSTRAINED (DC OFF). SIX-BOX: (1) PRIOR: init_t minimum at t=0.5 (rmse0.01360, BEST) > t=0.4(0.01429) > t=0.2(0.01908) > t=0.7(0.02248). Locked t=0.5. All hr=0; best rmse ~2.6x the calibrated FBP floor. (2) Failure mode: with the hard CG DC-projection OFF, the ONLY sinogram-fidelity term is the DPS soft gradient scaled by eta; at eta=1.0 it is too weak to pull the prior-perturbed estimate back onto the measured 128-view data. (3) ONE KNOB: fd_recon_eta 1.0->2.0 at locked t=0.5, steps=8. (4) HYPOTHESIS: stronger DPS guidance lowers calibrated RMSE toward the FBP floor; this is the closest DC-off can come to emulating the DC-on data term. If even 2x eta cannot clear hr>0, it confirms DPS-alone (no hard CG) is structurally below baseline on sparse breast -- the intended contrast vs the DC-on sibling. (5) BUDGET: <5min. (6) Loop continues.
